    • unifiedEncodeBase64

      public String unifiedEncodeBase64(long fid, long userId)
      Encodes string in Base64 with URL safe alphabet. Depending on application configuration. It will also add a 'n' sized array of letters between id's which will greatly increase the combinations encoding can have even if id's are same for all items.

      This can be configured in 'application.properties' with keys:

      • "encode-randomize-strings" to turn this feature on, default true
      • "encode-randomize-alphabet" set the letters to use, default alphabet
      • "encode-randomize-alphabet-size" set size of the randomized string, default 3 max value is 32

      Changing any of these later will not have any negative impact

      Parameters:
      fid - File or Folder id
      userId - User id
      Returns:
      BASE64 encoded with URL safe alphabet
